SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_purchase_timestamp,
  MIN(o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS order_delivered_customer_date,
  ABS((CAST(MIN(o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS DATE) - CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE)))::INT AS delivery_time_days,
  MIN(LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10)) AS seller_id,
  LEFT(o.customer_id, 10) AS customer_id,
  MIN(s.seller_zip_code_prefix) AS seller_zip_code_prefix,
  MIN(c.customer_zip_code_prefix) AS customer_zip_code_prefix,
  MIN(sgeo.geolocation_lat) AS seller_latitude,
  MIN(sgeo.geolocation_lng) AS seller_longitude,
  MIN(cgeo.geolocation_lat) AS customer_latitude,
  MIN(cgeo.geolocation_lng) AS customer_longitude,
  2 * 6371 * ASIN(
    LEAST(1, SQRT(
      POWER(SIN(RADIANS(MIN(cgeo.geolocation_lat) - MIN(sgeo.geolocation_lat)) / 2), 2)
      + COS(RADIANS(MIN(sgeo.geolocation_lat))) * COS(RADIANS(MIN(cgeo.geolocation_lat)))
        * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(MIN(cgeo.geolocation_lng) - MIN(sgeo.geolocation_lng)) / 2), 2)
    ))
  ) AS distance_km
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN geolocation sgeo ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = sgeo.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
JOIN geolocation cgeo ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = cgeo.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND sgeo.geolocation_lat IS NOT NULL
  AND sgeo.geolocation_lng IS NOT NULL
  AND cgeo.geolocation_lat IS NOT NULL
  AND cgeo.geolocation_lng IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY LEFT(o.order_id, 10), LEFT(o.customer_id, 10);
